models.export_bounds_note: rest/bind pose from the POSITION accessor (height includes the bristle crest; depth = snout tip to tail tip); animated envelopes per clip are in checks/glb_inspect.json (animated_bounds_m)

design_dimensions_R.brief_envelope: small, long-legged, bristly, dark/brown (brief form R); no measured source

skeleton.naming: ANIMAL-001 quadruped scheme unchanged: root (non-deforming, never animated), pelvis, spine1, spine2, neck, head, tail1, tail2, leg_{FL,FR,HL,HR}_{1,2,3}; F/H = front/hind, L/R = animal's left (+X) / right (-X), 1/2/3 = upper/middle/lower (3 carries the hoof); no jaw/ear bones

anchor_notes.base_center: exported node on the root (identity, floor point between the hooves)
anchor_notes.head_lead: exported node on bone 'head' under the jaw/throat (rope/halter or herding-stick target point, same convention as ANIMAL-001); Godot imports it as Skeleton3D/head (BoneAttachment3D)/head_lead

animations.name: idle
animations.behaviour: standing; weight sway, two breaths, slow head turn, tail swish; all four hooves planted

animations.name: walk
animations.behaviour: in-place lateral-sequence walk (HL, FL, HR, FR at 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 of a stride), duty 0.62, 2 strides per 1 s loop (stride 0.50 m); planted hooves move back at the authored 1.0 m/s
animations.contact_speed_note: median speed of each hoof between consecutive 120 Hz samples in which its lowest vertex is within 2 mm of the floor (independent GLB skinning); -Z = backwards = the animal moving forward at that speed

animations.name: root_forage
animations.behaviour: nosing/rooting the ground (e.g. for acorns under oaks): forequarters lowered by bending the front legs, head down with the snout disc at the soil (lowest snout vertex ~4 mm above y=0 at the deepest press), three press-forward-and-flick pushes per 3 s loop while the head sweeps slowly left/right; hooves planted

animations.name: lie_down
animations.behaviour: stand -> head lowered -> front carpi (knees) to the floor while hind legs stay planted -> hindquarters fold down -> sternal lying; ends on lie_idle frame 0

animations.name: lie_idle
animations.behaviour: sternal lying, legs folded (hind legs to the sides), breathing, slow head turn

animations.name: stand_up
animations.behaviour: lying -> head lunge -> hindquarters rise first (front still kneeling) -> front legs unfold -> standing; ends on idle frame 0

reference_ids: S22 p. 12 (no bones survive, acid soil)
KY16 p. 227 (regional: farming always based on cattle, pig, sheep/goat; cite only)
SP23 section 3.5 p. 9 (cooked/uncooked pork proteins detected; preprint, immunological)
C19 p. 295 (acorns possibly animal fodder; authors' interpretation)
reference_note: No reference image was adopted. No freely licensed image of a Bohemian LBA pig exists in the project references; the form follows the brief's R description only.
parts_and_uncertainties: E (negative, S22 p. 12): no animal bones survive at Breznice; pig presence there is a regional inference
E (regional, KY16 p. 227, cite only): Bohemian/Moravian farming communities were always based on cattle, pig and sheep/goat; no herd ratio inferred
E (local product, SP23 section 3.5 p. 9, preprint): pork proteins detected on Breznice samples (cooked pork positive in 13 of 18 samples); proves pork use, not live pig keeping on site, breed or look
E (C19 p. 295, authors' interpretation): acorns may have served as animal fodder; pigs rooting under oaks is an R demo scene
R: body size, long legs, narrow deep body, bristle crest, erect ears, straight tasselled tail, no tusks, coat colours and variant set, piglet stripes option
R: gait timing, stride, duty factor, walking speed 1.0 m/s (piglet walk 0.5 m/s, trot 1.0 m/s), rooting posture and rhythm, lying/rising sequence
R/F: herd composition and layout in the demo; the pen is a placeholder for FENCE-001
own_work_license: Unselected original project work; manager/owner decision
deviations: Brief is a proposal backlog, not a frozen pack: executed under the opus-v2 COMMON/RETURN contract; the repo intake tool does not know the ID and was neither run nor edited; independent measurements are supplied in checks/
FENCE-001 is not merged in this checkout: the demo uses a preview-only placeholder pen built from Godot primitives at the FENCE-001 brief size (5 x 4 m, 1.05 m high, 1 m gate gap)
Acorn litter and rooted-soil patches in the demo are preview-only primitives, not kit assets
Rig kept identical to ANIMAL-001 (20 joints, no jaw/ear bones) as the brief asks to follow its conventions exactly; rooting is head/neck/forequarter motion only
Piglet clips are idle/walk/trot only (as listed in the brief); piglet has no lie or forage clip
Preview sun uses shadow_bias 0.2 / normal_bias 4.0 like ANIMAL-001 (renderer setting, not part of the asset)
